question: A rectangular field measuring 50 m by 30 m has a circular fountain in the center with a diameter of 14 m. What is the area of the remaining field? (Use pi = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Length of field = 50 m

Breadth of field = 30 m

Diameter of circular fountain = 14 m ⇒ Radius = 7 m

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Area of circle = πr²

**Calculations:**

Area of rectangle = 50 × 30 ⇒ 1500 m²

Area of fountain = (22/7) × 7 × 7 ⇒ 154 m²

Remaining area = 1500 − 154

⇒ 1346 m²

**∴ Area of the remaining field = 1346 m².**
